snippet.title: Tycoon Tex Longplay (Commodore 16 Plus/4) [QHD]
snippet.description:
Game Info
---------------------------------------------------
Developer: Micro Projects
Publisher: Gremlin Graphics
Year of Release: 1985
Coding: Anthony Clarke
Graphics: Matthew Clarke

Game Review & Impressions
---------------------------------------------------
One of the earliest games I ever played, it also one of the first examples of an endless runner I can recall. Players must help the titular Tycoon Tex patrol his oil pipelines, leaping over cracks and shooting enemies as they appear.

I can't say this is a fun game, but there is some nostalgia factor as far as this is concerned.

Information & Trivia
---------------------------------------------------
- Game has no ending

Video Notes
---------------------------------------------------
- Played to level 10 then quit

Chapters
---------------------------------------------------
N/A
